# Phase 5 metrics (generated by backbone.fit_widths)

Run `experiments/2026-10-14_full_r18`, smoothing 1 profiles, minimum run 1.0 m. Errors = predicted - true total carriageway width (m), on Phase 3 scored segments; MAE is a mean, bias a median. `image_*` and `b2_same_*`: segments where the image gives a width (coverage). `image+b2`: image width, B2 where none. `b2`, `b0`: all segments.

Spearman correlation of confidence with |error| (8cm): {"val": -0.326, "test": -0.34}
